items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: I mean, they had Chip, they had Joe Johnson

ctx.x: Huh? His son plays millionaires. Oh yeah. He might remember something, Bill. Yeah. He was too small, but his mother could tell.
I had a man of trumpet players in those days. I mean, they had Chip, they had Joe Johnson, they had, let's see, come on trumpet players. Edwin Clemons, he was good. So many guys.
